scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 38 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-unteruhldingen-stollenwiesen-halb.story: From Uhldingen-Mühlhofen it runs 329 km to Uhldingen-Mühlhofen; allow about 5 h 40 of riding. It goes by way of Insel Werd, Storen-Wildsberg, Oterswil / Insel Eielen and Halbinsel. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from Germany into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
